title: fix(qa): correct eight stale checklist steps, give four recurring fixtures one command each, and bring the showcase advisories from 76 to 30
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNP69gnL1YUb368kmLct4Bn)_

Fixes #32168

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 2026-11-10 全量测试（#32135）的记录，修正测试台账里 8 处过时的步骤和基线；移动端登录冒烟测试连到没登记应用 scheme 的服务器时改为带原因跳过；四个反复卡住测试的环境（贡献者成员、隔离墙启动、带密码的外部数据库、上游断开的副本应用）各变成一条命令；showcase 启动时的作者期提示从 76 条降到 30 条。
- 为什么改：台账写错的地方会让测试员按错的步骤判失败；四个环境每轮都要手工重搭，相关测试项一直“因环境阻塞”；76 条提示会让人习惯性忽略启动输出。
- 风险与回滚：没有平台包代码（packages/** 一行未改），没有权限或审批语义变化。showcase 14 个对象加了字段分组，表单和详情页会出现分区标题；项目列表多了两列。整体可直接 revert。
- 先看：`examples/app-showcase/test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`（剩下 30 条各自的理由），`scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`；在 examples/app-showcase 下 `node node_modules/@objectstack/cli/bin/run.js validate --json` 看 warnings 数为 30；`pnpm exec vitest run test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位审核后合入。剩下的 30 条里有 11 条是权限/汇总字段可见性的取舍（白名单里写明了理由），若你希望改权限而不是保留，请另开卡。

## What changes

### A. Eight stale steps and baselines (seven items, each `revision` bumped with a `history` row citing #32135 and #32168)

Every claim was re-read in code at the base, and counts were taken from a live boot at 8523ef9a.

| # | Item | Stale claim → now |
|---|------|------|
| 1 | `platform-core.seed-integrity` r7 | steps[1] baseline `19 datasets / 132 rows` → `20 / 138` (adds `sys_exchange_rate` 4 and `showcase_invoice_line` 7; counted on boot) |
| 2 | `platform-core.seed-integrity` r7 | steps[5], acceptance[3] and negative[1] said the replay upserts → create-only `ignore` replay matched on `externalId` |
| 3 | `platform-core.boot-health` r14 | steps[3] banner `132 rows` → `138 rows`; compile-advisory count `65` → `30` (ask D) |
| 4 | `identity-auth.session-list-revoke` r4 | steps[3] revoked with the `set-auth-token` bearer (the signed form, answers 404) → the `token` from `list-sessions`; the row action's `recordIdParam` is `sessionId` (`revoke-session-match-guard.ts`) |
| 5 | `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` r14 | column `active` (no `is_active`); credentials in `signing_secret` / `headers_secret`, never `definition_json`; redeliver body key `deliveryId` |
| 6 | `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix` r8 | the seed has no null `annual_revenue` → steps[1] plants it (plus three dated rows), records the ids and deletes them after; no seed change |
| 7 | `platform-core.console-login` r5 | steps[4]/[5] → two legs, an in-app navigation and then a full reload, a screenshot each (they behave differently, #32138) |
| 8 | `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` r18 | steps[4] named `hq`, a location field (#32139) → keeps `annual_revenue`: the object has no rule-free text field besides `name`, which steps[3] and [8] filter on, and `tax_id`, `billing_email`, `churn_reason` each carry a rule |

### B. The hand-off smoke skips on a server that does not trust its scheme

`examples/app-showcase/e2e/mobile-signin-handoff.spec.ts` probes the hand-off once in `beforeEach`. Only the route's own unregistered-scheme refusal (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, message naming `com.example.showcase.e2e` as not a registered app scheme) skips, and the reason names `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` and how to fix the reused server. Any other answer goes to the unchanged assertions, and on CI (`process.env.CI`, where `reuseExistingServer` is off) it never skips. The config's comment says the same.

- Reused server **without** the scheme (stock `os dev` on :38461): `2 skipped`, reason captured from the JSON reporter.
- Server **with** `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES=com.example.showcase.e2e` (:38463): `2 passed` (1.8 s, 2.2 s).
- The assertion is not weakened: the same trusting server without a built Console failed both tests (no sign-in form) rather than skipping.

### C. The four recurring fixtures, one command each: `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`

Each subcommand replays the ledger entry that already describes its fixture and proves that entry's own premise before it reports success. It prints one JSON object and exits 0 on success, 1 when a step answers wrong (naming the step), and 2 when an input is missing (nothing started). `teardown --dir` stops only what its `fixture.json` recorded.

| Fixture | Command | Proved live |
|---|---|---|
| contributor-bound member | `contributor-member [--task]` (replays `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`) | the member sees 0 of the 12 seeded invoices, INV-1003 answers 404, its own invoice 200; `--task` gives it one assigned task it can read |
| walled boot | `walled-boot [--posture group]` (RUNNER.md "A walled boot is a fixture of its own") | `isolated` and `group`: `auth/config` reads `multiOrgEnabled: true`, the posture, `degradedTenancy: false`; the operator's current organization lets `admin/create-user` land a member with `membershipCreated: true`; teardown leaves nothing |
| credentialed external database | `external-database` (local scram-sha-256 PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1, or `OS_TEST_EXTERNAL_DB_URL`) | `POST /api/v1/datasources` with the printed body → status `ok`; a password-less login is refused; with neither input it refuses (exit 2) naming both. Passwords are generated per run and stay in the /tmp run directory (0600); none is committed |
| broken-upstream scratch app | `broken-upstream-app [--variant config-fault]`, `restore-upstream --dir` | the copy outside the tree boots with `Connector registered DEGRADED: showcase_mcp_tools`; the restore puts the script back |

The ledger points at them: the search recipe gains a `command` key (README documents it), `records-forms.calendar-interactions` r5 opts into the recipe through `fixtures.provisioning`, `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` r9 and `integration-system.connector-degraded-recovery` r7 name their commands, and RUNNER.md's walled entry names `walled-boot`, which every walled item already cites.

### D. Showcase author-time advisories: 76 → 30, the 30 allow-listed with reasons

`validate --json` before: 76 (49 `field-no-consumers`, 11 `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty`, 9 `security-rollup-source-unreadable`, 2 `security-rollup-source-row-scoped`, 2 `security-private-no-readscope`, 2 `flow-loop-body-uncontained`, 1 `title-unresolvable`). After: 30.

- **Fixed in metadata (46):** 44 fields placed in keyed `fieldGroups` sections on 14 objects (ADR-0085 §5: the derived form, detail and drawer layout). The field zoo's 13 groups mirror its own family comments. Every new heading has a zh-CN label (`check-i18n-coverage`: none new). The other 2 are `showcase_project`'s task roll-ups, now columns of the default project list.
- **Allow-listed (30)** in `examples/app-showcase/test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`, which runs the CLI's own `validate --json` and fails on an unlisted advisory or a stale entry (both directions checked by mutation):
  - 11 approval slates: the admin fallback is what the approvals items drive, and one flow is the unarmed bindings specimen.
  - 11 roll-up read postures, plus 2 owner-only private reads the grant comments already call intended.
  - 2 loop-body findings on the `loop { parallel }` fixture.
  - `semantic_zoo.notes`, the fixture's trailing untitled bucket.
  - the junction row's title.
  - 2 lint false positives (below).

## Why

QA run #32135 (the 2026-11-10 full checklist run) recorded three kinds of friction that are not platform defects. Eight ledger steps or baselines no longer match the code, so a runner following them scores a false FAIL. Four fixtures had to be rebuilt by hand on every run, so the items that need them sat at blocked(fixture). The hand-off smoke failed on a reused `os dev` server for a reason that is configuration, not product. The 76 boot-time advisories train a reader to skim past the boot output, which is where boot-health looks for regressions.

## Verification

All on head `10ce9777` (this branch with `origin/main` at `dee2e920` merged in):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 62 commands, each run with its exit code recorded: **62 × exit 0**. `--ran` on that record: `62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (exit 0).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0 (16 areas, 361 items; 10/10 recipes referenced, 16 item references resolved, 3 area-qualified).
- `examples/app-showcase`: `vitest run` 47 files, 546 tests passed; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0; `validate --json` 30 warnings, unchanged after merging #32034's lint change.
- The allow-list test fails in both directions: with an entry removed it names the unlisted finding, and with a bogus entry added it names the stale one ("allow-list entries that no longer fire").
- Dogfood `semantic-roles`, `field-zoo-roundtrip`, `field-zoo-value-shape`, `showcase-permission-zoo`: 108 passed. ESLint on the 19 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files: clean. `check-i18n-coverage`: OK, none new.

## Acceptance notes

- **One PR, not two.** The dispatch split A+B+C and D unless one PR stays under 3,000 changed lines; this one is 1,445 (`dispatch-gates`: +1306 / -139, 27 files).
- **Walled items point through RUNNER.md.** Every walled item already cites RUNNER.md's "A walled boot is a fixture of its own" entry, so `walled-boot` is named there once rather than copied into each item, where the copies would drift.
- **crud-roundtrip keeps `annual_revenue`.** The card suggested a plain text field; the object has none free of a rule besides `name` (see A, row 8).
- **30 allow-listed rather than zero.** Each of the 30 is the app meaning what it declares (or a lint false positive), with the reason beside its entry; changing permissions or approval routing to silence them would change what the checklist items test.
- **The allow-list test couples lint changes to the showcase suite** on purpose: a rule change that adds a showcase advisory now fails `examples/app-showcase` until the entry or the metadata is decided, the same footing as the no-startup-warnings bar.

## Out-of-scope findings

- **Lint false positives, one family (`field-no-consumers`, `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts`, domain:spec).** Neither reader below names the field in metadata the rule credits. Reach: `os validate --json` on the showcase reports both.
  - `showcase_invoice.owner` is read on every select by the `invoice_own_rows` RLS `using` predicate. `CARRIER_ROOTS` takes the whole `permissions` root as a carrier, although a sharing-rule condition is credited as behaviour.
  - `showcase_invoice_line.position` is the inline grid's line-position field, which the renderer derives from the child (`INLINE_GRID_SORT_FIELDS`, `packages/spec/src/data/inline-grid-sort-fields.ts`). The rule does not credit that derivation.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/**` is untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (ESLint run on the 19 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes: `examples/`, `docs/qa/`, `scripts/qa/`; labelled `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (All but the `## 维护者速读` block, which the dispatch asks for in Chinese.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
